messages:
mike-dev: CI turned red on main after the lockfile regen, tests failing in a weird import.
mike-dev: quick snippet from CI:
```
E   AttributeError: module 'importlib_metadata' has no attribute 'version'

venv/lib/python3.9/site-packages/somepkg/utils.py:12: in get_version
    return importlib_metadata.version('somepkg')
```
anna-eng: ugh, that smells like importlib-metadata vs stdlib importlib.metadata mismatch on py39
jordan-sre: can you paste the full failing test name and the top of the traceback? need to know which package triggers it.
mike-dev: test_config::test_version_resolution
mike-dev: top-of-trace:
```
tests/test_config.py:44: in test_version_resolution
    assert get_version() == '2.4.0'
E   AttributeError: module 'importlib_metadata' has no attribute 'version'
```
anna-eng: importlib-metadata 5.0 changed some internals; some packages import `importlib_metadata` directly and expect older API
mike-dev: locally on py310 the test passes. CI is using py39 image which picks importlib-metadata 5.x from the new lockfile
devops-ci: I looked at the lockfile diff — importlib-metadata moved from 4.x -> 5.0.0 as a transitive of `some-lib` bump
mike-dev: can you run a pipeline with the previous lockfile so we confirm it's the lock regen and not unrelated flakiness? CACHE=false would be ideal.
devops-ci: yep; I can rerun against the previous lockfile. do you want a full bisect or a quick revert pin?
anna-eng: temporary mitigation: add `importlib-metadata<5` to our constraints.txt or pyproject extras, but I'd prefer to find which package bumped it
jordan-sre: bisect seems best to identify the root cause. devops-ci can run jobs in parallel if you want to narrow quickly.
mike-dev: ok plan: (1) rerun pipeline with old lockfile (2) if green, do bisect to find which transitive caused the bump (3) open short-lived pin PR if bisect takes >1 day
mike-dev: local repro steps I'm sharing:
```
# reproduce the failing scenario locally
poetry install --no-root --no-dev --lock ./previous-poetry.lock
poetry run pytest tests/test_config.py::test_version_resolution -q
```
devops-ci: started rerun with old lockfile and CACHE=false — job id: 5678, link: https://ci.example.com/5678 :hourglass:
ci-bot: Pipeline 5678 started by devops-ci for commit abc123 (rerun previous lockfile)
anna-eng: if rerun is green I'll start the bisect: iteratively apply lockfile diffs or bump candidates
mike-dev: if you need a quick workaround for the rollout, I'm fine with a short PR pinning importlib-metadata<5 and a changelog note
jordan-sre: agreed. don't forget to add a comment linking to the CI job and mention which services/tests are affected
devops-ci: rerun finished — green. so the lockfile bump introduced the failing package version.
mike-dev: thanks. I'll open a bisect request issue and assign to anna-eng for the first pass.
anna-eng: taking it. I'll post back with a candidate bump to revert or a patch to constrain.
mike-dev: thanks all :thumbsup:
ci-bot: NOTE: added label `ci:red` to the original failing pipeline and `regression` to the new issue.
mike-dev: will follow up with PR later today, and add temporary constraint if bisect doesn't finish quickly. cheers.
